title: presence: float precision loss for large timestamps can bypass uint64 check
description: apply_automatic_status converts now to float via _finite_non_negative (line 279), then checks int(now_f) > _UINT64_MAX (line 280). For values near 2^63+, float64 precision loss means some out-of-range values pass validation. Either: (1) check integer bounds before float conversion, or (2) document that now must be realistic Unix epoch values.
